A Rare Vacant Stand in The Barnyard - Plot 5 | ±1,291 m² / R10 000 000 + VAT

Web Ref. SIR126663
Land size 1291.00 m²
Monthly Bond Repayment
R99,837.98
Plot 5 | ±1,291 m²
R10 000 000 + VAT

Set within the exclusive surroundings of The Barnyard in Constantia, Plot 5 presents an opportunity to design and build a bespoke residence in one of the area's intimate low-density estates.

The stand measures approximately 1,291 m². The approved subdivision layout identifies Portion 5 at approximately 1,291 m².

Positioned against the slopes of the Silvermine Mountains, The Barnyard consists of only 11 residential erven and has a distinctly rural character, with vineyards and environmentally sensitive wetland and watercourse areas forming part of its broader setting

The architectural approach is contemporary Cape barn, with the design guidelines encouraging homes that connect internal and external spaces through landscaped courtyards, terraces and gardens. Timber, stone and off-shutter concrete are among the natural materials encouraged within the estate's architectural language.

A maximum floor space of 500 m² applies to the newly subdivided residential portions, subject to applicable building lines, servitudes, estate architectural guidelines and all required approvals.

For the buyer wanting the freedom to create a home specifically for their lifestyle, Plot 5 offers a compelling opportunity within this special Constantia setting.
Monthly Levy R6,000

Offer Rules
You will be notified of other offers via email.

All sales are non-suspensive and sold as is "voetstoots". Properties on sale with a "Offers From" price will be sold subject to confirmation of the seller.
